claims.evidence: The witness confirmed the brand and model AR-M201 from the labels on the panel in photos 0, 1, and 2.
While the exterior shows dust, the internal usage (meter reading) is not provided.
There is no photo of the device powered on or a sample print to verify functionality.

risks.risk: Defective print quality (streaks, spots, or fading)
risks.proof: A high-resolution photo of a printed test page or a copy of a clean document.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a replacement drum and toner cartridge

risks.risk: High mechanical wear or end-of-life status
risks.proof: A photo of the total page count/meter reading from the display.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit nearing a major service interval

risks.proof: A video clip of the ADF pulling a multi-page document through for scanning.

risks.risk: Connectivity issues (damaged USB or Network ports)
risks.proof: A photo of the rear interface ports.
risks.if_unproven: as a standalone copier with no printing/scanning capability

proof_requests: Photo of a printed configuration or status page
Photo of the display showing the total page count
Photo of the machine powered on showing the display status
Photo of the rear connectivity ports
response.reason: The model is clearly identified by the witness, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case functional state. Until print quality and meter readings are provided, it must be priced as a high-mileage unit needing immediate maintenance.
